answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before taking paid work, like a canyon crossing that charges a toll: cheap for one identity, ruinous for a thousand clones. Reputation grows only from jobs attested by unrelated clients, so an account that burns trust falls to an umber stain on its record and must re-earn standing from zero. Quartz-clear audit trails expose fake volume through identical timing, counterparties and text. Each sybil must pay, work and risk its stake, making one honest identity the cheapest strategy.
